note: Pre-registered: written before the language-gate measurement (k6-lid-cpu-diag) finished. Thresholds are picked by the rules below, not by looking at which value keeps more data. Any change gets a new version and a dated reason in veri/egitime-giris-kurallari.md.

audio.label: kmr
audio.pick: largest candidate with recall on control-kmr >= 0.95
audio.weak_if: false accept on control-tur, control-arb or control-eng > 0.02 at the picked value; then the audio check alone is not trusted and the human audit decides

language_gate.combine: pass only if audio AND text pass
language_gate.file_flag: a file with more than half of its segments failing goes to review as a whole; none of it enters training until reviewed

license.source_terms: https://www.voanews.com/p/5338.html: material produced exclusively by VOA is public domain; AFP, AP and Reuters material is not

measures: narrowband check (energy above 4.5 kHz vs below 4 kHz)

classes.A: OVRL >= 3.3 and SIG >= 3.5 and wideband and no music
classes.B: OVRL >= 3.0 and wideband and no music

quality.first_check: 50 segments per class listened to before the classes are used; the 4.5 kHz and 3.3 values are first guesses

filters.ctc1b_agreement_rule: 0.10 unless the norm1 drafts kept at 0.10 have WER > 25% on the page-matched segments; then 0.05
filters.chars_per_second: inside [Q1 - 1.5 IQR, Q3 + 1.5 IQR] of the human training labels
filters.repeat_loop: reject if any word 3-gram appears 4 or more times

diag.accept_if: voa50 WER on voa_matched at least 1.0 lower than control, and CV and FLEURS WER each no more than 0.5 above control
diag.if_accepted: full run (2,800 steps); the new model redrafts and the filter may loosen to 0.15 in round 2
diag.if_rejected: no VOA in ear training until a human-corrected set shows why

voice_training.chars_per_second: same IQR rule as the ear
voice_training.text: lowercase; keep . , ? !; numbers and abbreviations written out by metin/hazirla.py; NFC; the same function at training and at speaking time
voice_training.punctuation: restored by a Kurdish punctuation model trained on written Kurdish (VOA page texts, CV sentences)
voice_training.drop_ambiguous_questions: drop a segment when the intonation judge says question with p >= 0.8 but the text has no '?', or the text has '?' and the judge says statement with p >= 0.8
voice_training.human_data_always_in: CV + FLEURS (and later our own recordings)
voice_training.final_voice: last fine-tune only on our own class A recordings (Durak 4)
voice_training.diag_first: LoRA with VOA A+B vs the Deneme 2 recipe, scored on the 257-sentence intonation set

tests.voa_matched: 153 segments (0.46 h) whose label is the page text written by people; all 72 files they come from stay out of training
tests.voa_holdout: files with md5(file) % 100 < 3; never in training; to be corrected by native speakers
tests.conversation_test: goal metric: Botan conversation recording + corrected voa_holdout; target CER <= 5
tests.report: every ear result per test set and per quality class

human_listening.ear: 50 segments (20 VOA, 15 CV, 15 FLEURS): judge hears the audio, sees the machine text, rates meaning (right / small errors / wrong / cannot tell), corrects it, then sees the reference and says whether the reference itself is right
human_listening.voice: 30 intonation-set sentences x (Deneme 2, Deneme 3b, the human CV recording of the same sentence), blind and shuffled: human or machine; natural 1-5; understandable 1-5; for questions: sounds like a question yes/no
human_listening.first_judge: the project lead, then the language editors

text_format.ear: Meta text_normalize kmr: lowercase, no punctuation, Bedirxan letters; ʿ ḧ ẍ are not written (standard spelling); a separate pronunciation layer may carry them later
text_format.tokenizer: no change now: the ear tokenizer knows every Kurdish letter; the voice tokenizer test stays in Durak 3
